title: Portuguese Beef Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make recipe for beef skewers with a smoky twist, inspired by Portuguese cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together red pepper flakes, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Thread the marinated beef onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges and parsley if desired.
